fact: Madagascar's tax administration steering committee reported the Integrated Tax Administration System (SAFI), covering online tax declaration and diversified payments, tested and ready for production deployment from the end of September 2025.
Minister Rindra Rabarinirinarison says the new Integrated Tax Administration System (SAFI) allows 24/7 online tax declarations and payments.
Minister says the e-Hetra online tax declaration and payment system has been expanded nationwide.

Madagascar's tax administration (DGI), relayed by Cabinet Fenitra on 16 October 2025, confirmed the integrated tax administration system SAFI went into production after a steering committee on 18 September 2025, with existing tax services migrating from end-September 2025.
